properties.POI_Description: The Battle of Hattin took place on July 4, 1187, near the Horns of Hattin, about 5 km west of Tiberias. The Crusader army of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, led by Guy de Lusignan, faced the Muslim forces commanded by Saladin of the Ayyubid dynasty. The Muslim victory led to the rapid reconquest of most of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem.
